meta.selection_rule: of the 1000 evaluation episodes (gymnasium seeds 100000-100999), the successful one of median length (the lower median of the 998 successful lengths, 76 steps); of the 35 episodes of that length the lowest seed: episode 15 (gymnasium seed 100015)
meta.agreement_baseline_raw_state_definition: the same readout (softmax, cross-entropy) on the raw six numbers, trained on the same states as the photonic readout (including the states added by DAgger)
meta.agreement_definition: held-out expert demonstrations: the expert swinging up from 500 new gymnasium starts (states never used in training), as in the paper
meta.swings_definition: back-and-forth swings of the first link: sign changes of dθ1/dt over the episode
meta.det_by_wl_definition: per frame, 8 lists of K values: detected power of each output at each wavelength, input power 1 at every wavelength; their mean over the wavelengths is det
meta.contrib_definition: per frame, 3 lists of 8 values: contrib[a][w] = sum over the wavelengths k of W[a, 8k + w] det_by_wl[w][k]; contrib[a] summed over w plus readout_bias[a] is scores[a]; W is the minimum-norm readout (its sum over the 8 detectors is 0 at every wavelength)
meta.drawing: pivot at (0, 0), y up, link lengths 1: elbow = (sin θ1, −cos θ1), tip = elbow + (sin(θ1+θ2), −cos(θ1+θ2)), as gymnasium renders it; the line is at height 1. Between frames, interpolate the two angles (taking the short way across ±π), not the positions

sweep.definition: per frame, sweep_col_power[j] and sweep_arm_power[j] are col_power and arm_power at the single wavelength wavelengths_nm[j] (index wavelength_index[j] into meta.wavelengths_nm), input power 1 at every wavelength, 3 significant digits, in every frame but the last (the state with the tip above the line, never swept); the last column of sweep_col_power[j] is det_by_wl at that wavelength. The animation sweeps the wavelength across meta.wavelengths_nm at every step, shows the light in the network at the current wavelength (interpolated between these wavelengths) and draws each detector's reading (det_by_wl, all K wavelengths) as the wavelength advances

mesh.arm_profile: each arm: width 500 nm, then piecewise-linear through the 5 listed widths, back to 500 nm; 7 points equally spaced over the 10 um taper
mesh.upper_is: the first (lower-index) waveguide of each pair; waveguide 0 is drawn at the top

encoding.description: one observation number per waveguide, as the paper's figure feeds 6 of the 8 waveguides: waveguides 1-6 carry cos th1, sin th1, cos th2, sin th2, dth1/dt, dth2/dt in that order; phase = 0.5 pi x the number for the four cos/sin numbers and 2 pi x the number divided by its bound (4 pi and 9 pi rad/s) for the two angular velocities; waveguides 0 and 7 carry unmodulated light at phase 0, a phase reference; equal amplitude on every lit waveguide (lit_ports), total input power 1; phases given modulo 2 pi
encoding.name: figref_ahalfpi_v2pi
encoding.phase_rule: in_phase[p] = sum over j of coeff_rad[p][j] * obs[j] / obs_bounds[j], modulo 2 pi; 0 on ports that carry no state (reference_ports carry unmodulated light at phase 0; ports not in lit_ports carry no light)
